import type { CoachMarkStep, CoachMarkBoundary, CoachMarkContract, TutorialStopDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
/** Adjacent native insertion preserves the actual host target, its input state and IME. */
export declare class CoachMark extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        steps: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        boundaries: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        stepId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        defaultStepId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        onTargetAction: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        startActionId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        fallbackFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        waiting: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        missing: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        linked: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        verificationFailed: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    steps: readonly CoachMarkStep[];
    boundaries: readonly CoachMarkBoundary[];
    stepId: string | undefined;
    defaultStepId: string | undefined;
    onTargetAction: CoachMarkContract['onTargetAction'];
    startActionId: string;
    fallbackFocusId: string;
    private waiting;
    private missing;
    linked: boolean;
    private verificationFailed;
    private presentStepId;
    private focusStepId;
    private openState;
    private stepState;
    private boundary;
    private nativeTarget;
    private observer?;
    private generation;
    private pendingStop;
    constructor();
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    get committedStep(): CoachMarkStep;
    private route;
    private resize;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private stopDetails;
    start(): void;
    stop(reason?: TutorialStopDetails['reason']): void;
    private clear;
    private change;
    private targetAction;
    updated(): void;
    private recovery;
    private position;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
